validation_cuts: No Governors owner cuts. Source-closed WMD and Improvements counts locate prefix from Quests.end; enclosing Player.end is contextual bound. Comparison uses original full records. No production offsets/traces.
allocation_policy: Aggregate list entries and encoding-0 bytes count as items; full no-allocation scan checks every nested extent and cumulative typed storage <= isize::MAX before fallible reservations. Encoder measures complete wire/items/storage before output allocation. Capacity is preserved metadata, never an allocation request.
native_read_effects: Recycled reader may destroy/reserve and AddAt, reconstructs free links; Governor reader writes definition-remapped types/promotions and inserts city-map entries. These effects are not executed by wire codec.
